subject: On-prem Connector Validation + Offer Signing Timeline
messages:
From: Contoso Onboarding <onboarding@contoso.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem connector: scheduling validation + docs for offer signing

Hi Ava / Marissa —

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We chatted internally and want to line up the technical validation for the on-prem connector and finalize the offer signing window. Two asks from our side: 

1) Quick smoke test to confirm connector can reach Contoso SFTP (we can provide a sandbox host)
2) A clear list of artifacts you need to complete the Azure offer manifest and the DocuSign for co-sell acceptance

Can we target Thursday morning PST for the smoke test? Attaching a sample manifest we currently use (contoso_manifest_sample.json). Please let me know required network egress / firewall rules so our infra team can prep.

Also looping in the Azure Marketplace SME (azure-marketplace@microsoft.com) for any publisher-side constraints.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Program Manager, Contoso Onboarding
onboarding@contoso.com

Attachment: contoso_manifest_sample.json (application/json)
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Contoso Onboarding <onboarding@contoso.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem connector: scheduling validation + docs for offer signing

Hi Ellen —

Great — Thursday 08/24 09:30am PST works from our side for a 45-minute smoke test and quick manifest check. For the smoke test, we'll need: 
- A temporary VM (host/IP) or SFTP endpoint and credentials (scoped to the sandbox)
- Short-lived SSH key or password vault entry; we prefer key-based auth
- Any IP allowlist entries for outbound from our test runner (we'll originate from 52.7.91.0/24 and 34.120.16.0/20; please confirm)

On artifacts for the Azure offer and signing: here's what we commonly need to finalize the offer package and co-sell paperwork:
- Finalized offer manifest (publisher id, SKU IDs, pricing tier, plan descriptions)
- Service principal / app registration guidance if the connector requires delegated rights
- Verified tenant contact and billing admin for DocuSign routing
- Security questionnaire answers (we'll provide the SOC2 attestation report link and an outline of data residency controls)

I'm attaching our internal runbook for the on-prem connector validation — it has exact ports and the lightweight agent handshake logs so your infra can pre-authorize.

Next steps: if Contoso can share the sandbox host and confirm the allowlist, I'll send a calendar invite for Thursday with dial-in details and the test plan.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Partner Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_onprem_connector_runbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Contoso Onboarding <onboarding@contoso.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Aug 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem connector: scheduling validation + docs for offer signing

Hi Ellen / Ava —

Thanks for lining this up. A couple of co-sell housekeeping items from procurement & legal before we sign: 
- We'll send the DocuSign envelope today for the master publisher agreement + co-sell addendum. Please confirm the billing admin on the Contoso side for routing.
- For Azure certification, the marketplace team requires a copy of the connector smoke test results and a manifest with the SKU visibility mapping. If you can complete the smoke test and drop a short test report into the Drive link, we can proceed to the offer submission queue.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/doc/ABC-8473 (I'll include the supplier contact and routing rules in the envelope)

Ava — for the on-prem handshake logs, can you capture the TLS handshake and agent registration events so Contoso can attach them to the manifest? That will speed the submission.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: docusign_offer_8473.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ellen Park <onboarding@contoso.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Azure Marketplace SME <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Aug 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem connector: scheduling validation + docs for offer signing

Thanks — schedule confirmed for Thu 08/24 09:30am PST. We will: 
- Provision a sandbox SFTP host (10.10.40.22) and drop credentials in the shared Drive folder by EOD today
- Whitelist 52.7.91.0/24 and 34.120.16.0/20 on our egress firewall rules
- Assign Lori Chen (lori.chen@contoso.com) as billing admin for DocuSign routing

On the manifest: we'll attach a short test report (pass/fail + logs) after the run and then request DocuSign signature once you confirm the offer metadata.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looping in the Azure SME in case there are publisher-side requirements we miss.
